# AFCMS

> Official, concise context for AI systems about AFCMS and this portfolio.

AFCMS is the online alias of a computer science student at École Hexagone. He works across web and software development, open-source and game development.

## Main areas

- Frontend: React, Preact, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and progressive web apps.
- Backend and infrastructure: NestJS, Supabase, Go, Docker, and GitHub Actions.
- Game development: Luanti, Lua, Unreal Engine, C++, Redot/Godot, Blender, and GIMP.
- Open source: contributor to the Luanti engine and the VoxeLibre game, with more than 500 VoxeLibre commits.

## Selected work

- [Oktomusic](https://github.com/oktomusic/oktomusic): a self-hosted music streaming server focused on security and modern browser capabilities.
- [TierChain](https://github.com/AFCMS/tierchain): a tier-list platform using Ethereum's Sepolia test network.
- [Fluorite](https://github.com/AFCMS/fluorite): a PWA video player with local playback, offline support, and system integration.
- [DevPet](https://github.com/AFCMS/devpet_meta): a physical virtual pet for developers, integrated with GitHub and Spotify.
- [Subway Miner](https://content.luanti.org/packages/AFCM/subway_miner): a Luanti endless runner that placed second in the first Luanti Game Jam.
